gui.forja.libros.probador.razon.sealed: Sealed pact: open it first with its offering at the star.
gui.forja.libros.probador.sinergia_dormi: With %s it would make "%s", but three are awake already: it would sleep.
gui.forja.libros.pacto_sellado.desc: What it gives and what it costs is not known until it is opened. It opens once, offering what it asks at the star.
gui.forja.libros.pacto_sellado.corto: Opens with an offering at the star
gui.forja.libros.sinergia_dormida.desc: You have not woken them yet. Each appears here the first time it wakes on something you carry: two upgrades that get on, both at 50 %% or more. The upgrade probe says when a piece is close.
gui.forja.libros.probador.sinergia_ocult: With %s it would wake a synergy you do not know yet.
gui.forja.libros.probador.pliegues: Click a group to open it: what each upgrade does, how far it goes and its recipe.
gui.forja.libros.fundicion_sabes: So far the forge table has worked cold: parts cut, forged and upgraded. What you put under it changes that. With heat, two metals become one, parts melt back down and metal is cast. It is the road to the best alloys and to the greater forge table.
gui.forja.libros.catalogo.aleaciones: Every alloy, by the heat it asks for: what goes in, what comes out and how much.
gui.forja.libros.fundicion_siguiente: With the greater table the part of the smith's path learned in the workshop ends. What comes next: getting everything out of a piece, and going out into the world to find the Smith's castle.
gui.forja.libros.mayor_sabes: The greater forge table makes everything the first one will not (greatswords, spears, shields, flails, wings...) and takes upgrades from %s%% up to %s%%. But not everything fits on every piece: each has a potential and a load. This book tells how far a piece can go, and how far you can.
gui.forja.libros.mayor_siguiente: What is left: a class that makes your way of fighting your own, and going out into the world to find the Smith's castle.
advancements.forja.leer_clases.title: Your Way of Fighting
gui.forja.libros.clases.cerradas: The classes open with their book: make it and read it (a book and an emerald).
gui.forja.libros.clases_sabes: A class is your way of fighting, or of forging: seven, each with its numbers, two skills and a talent tree that grows with experience. Opening this book for the first time is what opens them: from now on you can choose yours with **%s** or with the button below. The first one is free.
gui.forja.libros.clases_siguiente: With your class chosen, what is left is out there: the ruins, the Smith's castle and what lies beyond.
gui.forja.libros.bastion_sabes: Outside the workshop there are abandoned forges with their chests, villagers who sell what you cannot make, commissions that pay well and ruins with guardians. And, somewhere not far from the world's origin, the smiths' guild castle, where the road to the Fallen Smith begins.
gui.forja.libros.ruinas.forja: In plains, forests and other village biomes: both tables, a chest with engraved templates, gear and orbs, and an automaton still guarding it. The master toolsmith and the Forger sell its map.
gui.forja.libros.ruinas.castillo: A small deepslate-brick castle in hills, mountains and savanna plateaus: crenellated wall, four towers with lanterns and, in the middle, the stamping hall of the **Die Guardian**. While one of the three ember lanterns on its pillars burns, nothing hurts it. It keeps the best chest of its size.
gui.forja.libros.ruinas.nether: A blackstone fortress with lava channels, two automatons and, in the middle, a dead forge. It is older than the Bastion: a click on its forge opens it into a portal frame like the Deep Forge's, lit the same way, with four orichalcum pearls.
gui.forja.libros.herrero_historia: The smiths' guild raised the Bastion to keep its craft: eleven towers, one for each workshop, and beneath them the crypt of the Nine Masters. The last master smith wanted to forge with what falls from the sky, and lit in the Deep Forge a fire that was not of this world.
gui.forja.libros.herrero_historia.dos: The fire took him. His forge went dead, his apprentices with him, and since then he works in a graveyard of weapons among the stars. He is the Fallen Smith. His forge heart is the finest material there is.
gui.forja.libros.bastion.donde: Every world has a Guild's Bastion between 1,500 and 4,500 blocks from the origin, on flat, dry ground away from villages, and more scattered over the world. A level 5 Forger sells its map, and /locate finds it.
gui.forja.libros.bastion.dentro: Eleven towers with their workshop's room on every floor, a courtyard, halls and apprentices' houses; underground, the crypt, the ossuary, dungeons, the cellar, the vault and the Deep Forge. Some ninety monsters guard it, and the loot goes by room: the vault and the crypt hold the best.
gui.forja.libros.bastion.forja: At the bottom of the castle, where the master's forge burned, there is a five-by-five frame with four empty brackets. It is the door to the Smith's world.
gui.forja.libros.bastion_siguiente: With the portal lit you learn the last book's recipe, and find one beside the frame.
advancements.forja.portal.title: Among the Stars
gui.forja.libros.cementerio.meseta: A plateau of ash alone in the void, sown with weapons stuck in the ground like graves, with cold ruined forges and rivers of molten metal that burn like lava and fall over the edge. In the middle, the arena. There is no sleeping and no setting your spawn there, and it is always night.
gui.forja.libros.cementerio.pelea.resume: He falls from the sky as soon as you arrive. He has **three stages**: at two thirds and one third he drives his hammer in and his apprentices rise. At half he **reforges** and cannot die while his star embers burn: tip the **braziers** over. The **constellations** help one side or the other. Dead or beaten, the fight waits for you.
gui.forja.libros.cementerio.llegada: Entering his world with no fight under way, a few seconds later a star falls on the arena, sends out a purple wave as it lands and the Smith rises. While he falls and settles he cannot be hurt.
gui.forja.libros.cementerio.braseros: Only the pour of one of the arena's braziers puts out his embers: tip it with a blow or an arrow, and it pours on the ember in front of it. Each brazier tips once; it is refilled with %s star irons. While he reforges, his hammer calls down meteorites. When the last ember goes out he is stunned for a few seconds and takes more damage.
gui.forja.libros.cementerio.constelacion: Every half minute one of the sky's eight constellations lights up and acts. Sword, Axe, Shield and Scythe help the Smith (a red warning, with a bell); Hammer, Spear, Anvil and Tongs help the players (a mint warning): meteorites on him, spears of light, healing, and the apprentices pushed aside.
gui.forja.libros.cementerio.estrella: Everyone who fights takes one. At the greater forge table, on a finished piece (one per piece): its potential can reach %s and rises %s, damage and mining %s and durability %s. On armour, +%s armour and +%s toughness per piece.
gui.forja.libros.cementerio.botin: His forge heart, a legend, the master's hammer, his anvil the first time, and a **Star of Return**: right click and it takes you back to the portal you came through.
gui.forja.libros.cementerio.revancha: A cold star forge is left in the middle of the arena. To fight again, give it an orichalcum pearl, three orichalcum, a Nether star and sixteen star irons. The fight is kept if you die or leave, and stops when nobody is left in his world.
gui.forja.libros.cementerio.ficha: His page writes itself the first time you see him.
gui.forja.libros.cementerio.fin: Here the guide ends. What is left is yours: better pieces, the rematch, the whole world. To keep them together, the smith's shelf holds the eight books, each in its place.
gui.forja.libros.estanteria_bloque: Click with a forge book and it goes to its place; click on a book in the shelf and it comes back to your hand. A comparator counts how many it holds.

trait.forja.ascua.largo: While you burn: +2.5 damage and 3 durability mended every 5 seconds. Armor: fire burns out 35% sooner per piece.

trait.forja.solar.desc: It hits harder in full sun

trait.forja.nocturno.desc: It hits harder in the dark
trait.forja.nocturno.largo: Where the light does not reach (level 7 or less): +3.5 damage. Armor: Speed I, and night vision with all four pieces.
trait.forja.vivo.desc: It feeds on what it kills
trait.forja.vivo.largo: Every kill mends it 25 durability; when it is already whole, it heals you half a heart.

trait.forja.acuatico.largo: Tools: mine at full speed underwater. Weapons: Impaling II. Armor: swim faster and hold your breath longer.
trait.forja.igneo.largo: Weapons and tools: set targets on fire. Bows: flaming arrows. Armor: fire burns out sooner.
trait.forja.afilado.desc: More damage while it is new
trait.forja.afilado.largo: Weapons and tools: up to +3 damage, fading as it wears. Armor: Thorns I.
trait.forja.del_end.largo: Tools: 30% chance to send drops to your inventory. Weapons: 10% chance to teleport the target. Armor: 5% per piece to dodge a hit.
trait.forja.llanto.largo: At night it repairs 2 durability every 5 seconds.
trait.forja.resonante.largo: Tools: breaking an ore outlines the same ore within 6 blocks, through walls. Weapons: +1 Breach. Bows and crossbows: +1 Piercing. Armor: immune to Darkness and Blindness.
trait.forja.pegajoso.largo: Everything: +1 Unbreaking. Weapons and tools: Slowness II for 2 s on hit. Bows and crossbows: Slowness for 3 s. Armor: attackers are slowed 1 s per piece.
trait.forja.acorazado.desc: Stands up to arrows and blasts
trait.forja.acorazado.largo: Armor: +1 Projectile Protection and +1 Blast Protection per piece. Weapons and tools: +20% knockback resistance in hand.

gui.forja.clase.guerrero.desc: Endure, parry, break. A little more health and damage, much more stamina, more posture damage and a more forgiving parry window. Magic comes out weak (×0.4).
gui.forja.clase.asesino.lema: More stamina, more dodge, less health
gui.forja.clase.asesino.desc: More stamina, more dodge, a little more damage, a lot less health. Dodges farther, more often and for less, and punishes from behind. Magic comes out weak (×0.4).
gui.forja.clase.tanque.desc: Lots of health, normal stamina, less mobility, shorter dodges and slower feet, and all its damage ×0.67. In return: armor, knockback resistance and a shield that tires you less.
gui.forja.clase.mago.desc: Magic, harder and sooner: more spell damage, shorter cooldowns, more mana that refills faster. Paid for in health, stamina and melee damage (×0.7).
gui.forja.clase.curandero.lema: Their magic heals, and barely harms

gui.forja.clase.arquero.desc: A hunter at range: more projectile damage, faster draw, more speed and better dodges, and lands softer. A little less health, and weaker in melee (×0.7).
gui.forja.clase.herrero.desc: Levels up by forging. An easier perfect strike, more potential in what they forge, repairs that go further and faster mining.
